🔥 likec4 | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate and maintain up-to-date software architecture diagrams directly from source code, enabling better visualization and collaboration on architectural designs.
✨ Key Features: • Architecture as code • Generates diagrams from code • Inspired by C4 Model and Structurizr DSL • Customizable notation, element types, and nesting levels • Live preview with CLI
📖 Summary: LikeC4 is a tool that generates software architecture diagrams directly from code, inspired by the C4 model. It allows for visualization, collaboration, and evolution of architecture by treating it as code, offering flexibility in defining custom notations and element types.
